1: // Endless Asteroid Dodge
2: // Simple canvas game: ship moves with arrow keys/WASD, shoots with space.
3: // Asteroids spawn from edges and drift inward. Game speeds up over time.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   /*** Setup ***/
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   const width = canvas.width;
10:   const height = canvas.height;
11: 
12:   /*** Game state ***/
13:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, r: 10, angle: 0, speed: 2 };
14:   const bullets = [];
15:   const asteroids = [];
16:   let keys = {};
17:   let lastSpawn = 0;
18:   let spawnInterval = 2000; // ms
19:   let lastTime = 0;
20:   let gameOver = false;
21:   let score = 0;
22:   let speedFactor = 1;
23: 
24:   /*** Input ***/
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
27: 
28:   /*** Helpers ***/
29:   function randRange(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }
30:   function distance(ax, ay, bx, by) { return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by); }
31: 
32:   /*** Entity creation ***/
33:   function spawnAsteroid() {
34:     // choose edge
35:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
36:     let x, y, vx, vy;
37:     const radius = randRange(8, 20) * speedFactor;
38:     const speed = randRange(0.5, 1.5) * speedFactor;
39:     if (edge === 0) { // top
40:       x = randRange(0, width);
41:       y = -radius;
42:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
43:       x = width + radius;
44:       y = randRange(0, height);
45:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
46:       x = randRange(0, width);
47:       y = height + radius;
48:     } else { // left
49:       x = -radius;
50:       y = randRange(0, height);
51:     }
52:     // drift toward center
53:     const dx = width / 2 - x;
54:     const dy = height / 2 - y;
55:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
56:     vx = (dx / len) * speed;
57:     vy = (dy / len) * speed;
58:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: radius });
59:   }
60: 
61:   function fireBullet() {
62:     const angle = ship.angle;
63:     const speed = 5 * speedFactor;
64:     bullets.push({
65:       x: ship.x + Math.cos(angle) * ship.r,
66:       y: ship.y + Math.sin(angle) * ship.r,
67:       vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
68:       vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
69:       r: 2,
70:     });
71:   }
72: 
73:   /*** Game loop ***/
74:   function update(dt) {
75:     // Ship movement
76:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) ship.y -= ship.speed * speedFactor;
77:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) ship.y += ship.speed * speedFactor;
78:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed * speedFactor;
79:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed * speedFactor;
80:     // Keep ship inside canvas
81:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, ship.x));
82:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, ship.y));
83:     // Ship angle faces mouse? use direction of last movement
84:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) ship.angle = -Math.PI / 2;
85:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) ship.angle = Math.PI / 2;
86:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.angle = Math.PI;
87:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.angle = 0;
88:     // Shooting
89:     if (keys[' ']) { // space bar
90:       if (!keys['_spaceCooldown']) {
91:         fireBullet();
92:         keys['_spaceCooldown'] = true;
93:         setTimeout(() => (keys['_spaceCooldown'] = false), 200);
94:       }
95:     }
96:     // Update bullets
97:     bullets.forEach(b => { b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; });
98:     // Remove off‑screen bullets
99:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
100:       const b = bullets[i];
101:       if (b.x < 0 || b.x > width || b.y < 0 || b.y > height) bullets.splice(i, 1);
102:     }
103:     // Update asteroids
104:     asteroids.forEach(a => { a.x += a.vx * dt; a.y += a.vy * dt; });
105:     // Collision: ship vs asteroids
106:     for (const a of asteroids) {
107:       if (distance(ship.x, ship.y, a.x, a.y) < ship.r + a.r) {
108:         gameOver = true;
109:         break;
110:       }
111:     }
112:     // Collision: bullets vs asteroids
113:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
114:       const a = asteroids[i];
115:       let hit = false;
116:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
117:         const b = bullets[j];
118:         if (distance(b.x, b.y, a.x, a.y) < b.r + a.r) {
119:           hit = true;
120:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
121:           break;
122:         }
123:       }
124:       if (hit) {
125:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
126:         score++;
127:       }
128:     }
129:     // Spawn new asteroids
130:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval / speedFactor) {
131:       spawnAsteroid();
132:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
133:     }
134:     // Gradually increase difficulty
135:     speedFactor = 1 + score * 0.05;
136:   }

138:   function draw() {
139:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
140:     // Ship
141:     ctx.save();
142:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
143:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
144:     ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
145:     ctx.beginPath();
146:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
147:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
148:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
149:     ctx.closePath();
150:     ctx.fill();
151:     ctx.restore();
152:     // Bullets
153:     ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
154:     bullets.forEach(b => {
155:       ctx.beginPath();
156:       ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
157:       ctx.fill();
158:     });
159:     // Asteroids
160:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
161:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
162:       ctx.beginPath();
163:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
164:       ctx.fill();
165:     });
166:     // UI
167:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
168:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
169:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
170:     if (gameOver) {
171:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
172:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
173:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
174:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
175:     }
176:   }

181:     lastTime = timestamp;
182:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
183:     draw();
184:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
